purpose: Shows a GilbVeda type's name or picture as a button that opens a small popover with the type's definition and a link to its page in the ontology.
namedChanges: `useContext(QueryClientContext)` (line 50) is `useContext(TermDefinitionContext)`, and a missing provider throws; `typeDefinitionOnce(session, bare)` is `typeDefinitionOnce(read, bare)` and the effect's dependency `session` is `read`.

The link `defaultTermIri(bare)` (line 144) is `` `${termOrigin()}/base/t/${encodeURIComponent(bare)}` ``: the body of `defaultTermIri` (`src/lib/base/ontologyBrowse.ts` line 1644, `` `https://${host}/base/t/${encodeURIComponent(name)}` `` with `host` defaulting to the GilbVeda host) with `https://${host}` replaced by the term origin. The `ontology-ref` unit's `ontologyRefIri` is NOT the same function (it also trims, passes `http(s)://` through, reads CURIEs and picks the `e` plane for store ids), so it is not used.
`onOpenOntology` was already a prop in the source (not read from the shell); no change.

library.title: Type definition popover
library.note: Opens a type's definition and ontology link; to choose a type take type-chooser, for the picture alone take type-picture.
